name: B10-0058/2024 (The Left) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is a statement of position after deadly floods in Central and Eastern Europe. It expresses sympathy and thanks rescuers. It asks for more money and faster help for flooded regions, stronger action to cut emissions and adapt to climate change, and better protection of rivers and natural flood barriers. It also says poorer and older people suffer most and must be protected.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of requests to the European Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** Flood-hit regions in Poland, Romania, Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovakia, and future disaster victims.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to the Commission and member states, which decide whether to act.
